race.comment: LUCY STYLES (2) settled in the leading division then came home powerfully and scored at this circuit and distance last start, arriving more than 5 metres ahead of her rivals. Gets the same draw so can keep the ball rolling. KEAYANG HARLOW (1) has been about the mark in recent runs and continued the good form at the latest appearance when second at this circuit and distance This is stronger but she is aided by the ace draw. MY KGARI (3) is first up 12 weeks but won a couple of races here late in the last campaign and her strike rate at this venue stands at 50 per cent. Readied with a trial placing and draws well. Look out for any positive market movement. ALWAYS PROMISE ME (6) resumes off some decent form including a win here two back. Hasn't raced since May but should be ready to put his best foot forward on the back of three trials, winning two.
